Hey readers of /v/bodyweightfitness, here's some cool things I kind of stole, kind of invented. Try them out. I hope you enjoy them, in that fun semi-masochistic way we enjoy exercise.

60 second pullup challenge- I got this from a Youtube video, the main guy in the video wasn't doing it but a guy in the background was. And no, it's not as many pullups as possible in 60 seconds, we don't need that Crossfit type shit here. Actually you only do one pullup, 30 seconds up and 30 seconds down, trying to keep the motion as smooth as possible. Once you get really good you can turn this into the 2 minute pullup challenge, 60 seconds up and 60 seconds down. This will make you want to cry if you do it right, it's that intense.

20-rep pause-set HSPUs- 20 rep squats are considered to be the ultimate quads and glutes builder among weightlifters. Basically, the idea is to take a weight you could normally squat for 8-10 reps, and squat it for 20 by taking short "breaks" at the top of the movement as needed, thus staying under load for a long ass time and getting a ton of volume in with just one set. My change to this is simple, do it with handstand pushups, and it becomes the ultimate shoulder and triceps builder. Pause at the top and enjoy the blood rushing to your head, ahh.

[note- if you haven't read the beginner routine on here, then you probably won't know this, but HSPUs are incredibly variable in difficulty, just by adjusting the width of your hands. Do it at a width you could normally do for 8-10 reps, which for most people is going to be alot wider than shoulder width.]

One legged sprints- I got the idea for this from a book, which advocated doing one-legged hops to build your calves. I was looking through it for the first time in months the other day, found it, and thought, "You know what this needs? Forward motion." And thus the one-legged sprint was born. I've been doing it recently, and it gives a killer calf pump. I guarantee this would put some serious mass on beginner calves if they took to doing it regularly. Do it to failure, until you fall on the ground, basically. Sure you look ridiculous but do it for the gains!!!
